fields.name: input_consumed

fields.comment: true when the output reached expected_size exactly

fields.name: q
fields.comment: : the Q that was applied (1.0 when w == 1)

fields.name: size
fields.comment: byte length from the directory record

fields.name: declared_size
fields.comment: u32 at +0, a length in the container's own terms

fields.name: names
fields.comment: as written in the manifest, lower case

fields.name: stream_offset
fields.comment: offset of this run inside the whole stream

fields.name: callback
fields.comment: +0x1C, opaque token interpreted by the host

fields.name: written
fields.comment: false where the builder does not store

fields.name: pointer
fields.comment: mouse event position, mapped when the event arrived

fields.name: return_value
fields.comment: 0 for stage 0, 1 after init, 0 when inert

fields.name: called_fn_ptr
fields.comment: true only on the state==1 path

fields.name: bit_index
fields.comment: which bit was cleared, for evidence

fields.name: vectors
fields.comment: the same data in vector form

fields.name: link
fields.comment: the word the taken arm would build

fields.name: unconditional
fields.comment: true: it is a branch delay slot

fields.name: unconditional
fields.comment: true: it is a branch delay slot

fields.name: only_when_state_small
fields.comment: beq guards entry, not the slot write itself

fields.name: frame_counter
fields.comment: value at 0x270C40 when the frame starts

fields.name: elf_sha256
fields.comment: the shipped ELF this capture belongs to

fields.name: error
fields.comment: populated when the result is not Ok

fields.name: callee_token
fields.comment: provenance only; never cast to a native pointer

fields.name: menu_count
fields.comment: mode0's loop bound is count+1 on data we do not have yet

fields.name: menu_w
fields.comment: rect+16, from ADDIU r4,r0,240 -- also the atlas column width

fields.name: image
fields.comment: 640x448 RGBA8, opaque black where nothing drew

fields.name: sprite_drawn
fields.comment: true only when sprite_texture was actually blitted

fields.name: disc_iso_path
fields.comment: path to the disc image, as narrow text

fields.comment: finite, recognized input/state events to stdout
